fallback_ladder: AUTO -> route by task_type/risk -> (codex or claude) -> if CLI missing AND allow_mock=true -> MOCK_CODEX or MOCK_CLAUDE; if allow_mock=false -> fail-closed exit_code=127

fallback_conditions.note: mock fallback is NOT automatic. It requires allow_mock=True (set via --allow-mock-executor true, or auto-enabled when --mode dry-run). Without it, router returns preferred backend with fail-closed error_type='cli_missing_fail_closed' and exit_code=127.

force_mock_env_details.gap: FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1 is NOT read by FactoryConfig.from_env(); it does not auto-set allow_mock_executor=True in FactoryConfig. When FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1 causes is_available()=False, mock only kicks in if allow_mock is already True by other means (mode=dry-run or --allow-mock-executor). If allow_mock=False, router still fail-closes even with FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1.

worker_isolation.symlink_defense_detail: prepare_codex_home() creates symlinks from parent_home to worker_home for CODEX_HOME_SHARED entries. No path validation is performed: there is no check that (a) parent_home itself has not been replaced by a malicious symlink, (b) the symlink target resolves within an expected base directory, or (c) a CODEX_HOME_SHARED file in parent_home is not itself a dangling or escaped symlink. An attacker who controls parent_home (e.g. via CODEX_HOME env override or tmpdir race) can point worker_home/auth.json at any host path.

denylist_gaps: curl|bash (no space) — NOT caught; denylist pattern is 'curl | bash' with spaces
wget|bash (no space) — NOT caught; denylist pattern is 'wget | bash' with spaces
base64 decode pipe chains (echo <b64> | base64 -d | bash) — not covered
dd if=... of=/dev/... — disk-overwrite not covered

config_stack_assessment.order: user-global TOML -> project-team TOML -> project-user TOML -> runtime dict
config_stack_assessment.security_note: config.user.toml is project-local and git-ignored; it can override allow_mock_executor=true or timeout_seconds to very low values, which could be used to cause premature timeout failures. No schema validation or value-range enforcement on materialized TOML values.

sandboxed_executor_assessment.sandbox_provider_none_fallback: audit-only annotation only; no actual network enforcement

smoke_results.note: InputClassifierAgent is purely heuristic (no LLM call); FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK has no effect here but command succeeds cleanly.

smoke_results.test: deliver-project with PATH=/usr/bin (codex/claude absent) and --allow-mock-executor true
smoke_results.command: PATH=/usr/bin autodev deliver-project --project-brief examples/01-mdlines/brief.md --from-scratch true --mode dry-run --allow-mock-executor true --repo-path /tmp/executor-d-1
smoke_results.note: Mock fallback activated correctly when both CLIs absent and allow_mock=True. Confirms ladder: real CLI missing -> MOCK_CODEX/MOCK_CLAUDE used.

findings.title: No-space pipe variants bypass denylist
findings.detail: Patterns 'curl|bash' and 'wget|bash' (no spaces around pipe) are not caught by scan_prompt_for_unsafe(). The denylist checks for 'curl | bash' (with spaces). A prompt containing 'curl|bash' passes the safety check silently. Similarly, base64-decode-pipe chains and backtick substitutions are uncovered.
findings.recommendation: Normalize whitespace around '|' before denylist matching, or add tokenizer-based pattern matching. Add 'curl|bash', 'wget|bash', base64-pipe variants, and backtick substitutions to DEFAULT_DENYLIST.

findings.title: FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1 does not auto-set allow_mock_executor in FactoryConfig
findings.detail: FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1 causes both is_available() methods to return False, but FactoryConfig.from_env() does not read this env var to set allow_mock_executor=True. If the pipeline is invoked without --mode dry-run and without --allow-mock-executor true, the router will fail-closed (exit_code=127, error_type=cli_missing_fail_closed) even with FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1. This breaks the expected semantics of the env var in production test harnesses.
findings.recommendation: In FactoryConfig.from_env(), add: if os.environ.get('FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK') == '1': cfg.allow_mock_executor = True

findings.title: worker_isolator.prepare_codex_home() has no symlink-target path validation
findings.detail: prepare_codex_home() calls os.symlink(src, dst) for each entry in CODEX_HOME_SHARED without validating that src.resolve() stays within the expected parent_home directory. If parent_home is under attacker control (CODEX_HOME env var race, tmpdir attack), a malicious symlink in parent_home would be blindly re-symlinked into worker_home, granting worker processes access to arbitrary host paths via the shared auth.json, config.toml, etc.
findings.recommendation: Before os.symlink(src, dst), validate src.resolve().is_relative_to(parent_home.resolve()) and assert worker_home.resolve().is_relative_to(expected_workers_base). Raise ValueError if violated.

findings.title: SandboxedExecutor provides audit annotation only — no real network enforcement
findings.detail: SandboxedExecutor.execute() with sandbox_provider='none' (the default) adds a log annotation 'sandboxed/audit_only=True' to the result but does not block any actual network egress. The NetworkAllowlist evaluates domain verdicts but enforcement is deferred to a sandbox runtime that does not exist yet.
findings.recommendation: This is documented behavior. Ensure callers are aware that SandboxedExecutor does not provide real isolation in the current release.

findings.title: config.user.toml can override allow_mock_executor without schema validation
findings.detail: ConfigStack.materialize_into() writes arbitrary TOML scalar values to FactoryConfig attributes including allow_mock_executor and timeout_seconds with no range or type enforcement beyond Python's runtime attribute assignment. A malicious or misconfigured project .autodev/config.user.toml could silently disable mock safeguards or set timeout to 0.
findings.recommendation: Add pydantic or dataclass validation in materialize_into() to enforce minimum timeout values and acceptable boolean types.
